title: Contract changelog/README lost digest coverage and cloudflare contracts.mjs keeps a dead ticks-sync path
body: 4i8 deleted TestAnEditedChangelogIsRefused. contracts/CHANGELOG.md and README.md are no longer covered by any digest: only a '## <version>' heading is checked, so a past entry can be rewritten silently. cloudflare/scripts/contracts.mjs still carries the 'pinned' mode and contracts:sync, which fetch all 16 files from ticks, which ships two. cloudflare/CONTRACTS.md:35,114 still documents it. herdr-kinds.md:18 also links a heading (#the-helper-tk-herd) that no longer exists, and references_test.go ignores anchors.
demonstrating_check: go run ./cmd/contracts check (after editing an existing CHANGELOG entry)
